name: Noise Wake
description: Closes the screensaver as soon as the microphone hears sound above a threshold you set, and can keep it from starting while the room stays loud. The plugin measures the loudness on the device and never stores or sends audio.
author: Daniël de Jonge

settings.title: Enabled
settings.description: Turn Noise Wake off without disabling the plugin. While it is off, the microphone stays closed.

settings.title: Loudness threshold
settings.description: Sound at or above this level closes the screensaver. 0 is the loudest the microphone records, so a higher number (closer to 0) needs louder sound. Use Measure the room to find a good value.

settings.title: Minimum duration
settings.description: How long the sound has to stay above the threshold. 0 reacts to any spike. Raise it if single clicks or bumps wake the screen.

settings.title: Cooldown
settings.description: After waking the screen, ignore sound for this long.

settings.title: Also wake a display that is off
settings.description: Also listen while the display is off and turn it on when sound crosses the threshold.

settings.title: Stay awake while there is sound
settings.description: While sound stays above the threshold, keep the screensaver from starting. When it gets quiet, the normal screensaver countdown starts again. With this on, the microphone is open whenever the display is on, not only while the screensaver shows.

settings.title: Audio source
settings.description: The Android audio source to record from. Try another one if the level stays at silence or if the wake word stops working while the screensaver shows.

settings.title: Measure the room
settings.description: Keep the microphone open and show the live level in the status above, so you can pick a threshold. Turn it off when you are done, since the plugin otherwise only listens while the screensaver shows.
